messages:
maria_marketing: Quick sync — we need a short battlecard + SDR script for the webinar and the benchmark post next Wed. Focus: field signals vs cloud AI endpoints and infra vendors. Who can own messaging + one-pager?

josh_product: +1. Thesis: "serving-first" — predictable latency, routing/fallback, and clear econ levers (batching, caching, quant). Short lead lines for landing page: "Production-first inference: predictable latency & lower unit cost" vs "Cut inference spend with workload-aware serving".

sam_sdr: I need 2 subject lines + 2 lead hooks for SDR/outbound. Keep them < 10 words. Example: `Cut inference spend 30% — See the benchmark` and `Ship LLM features with SLA-backed latency`. Safe?

anya_research: Don’t state hard %s without backing. Suggested phrasing: "Reduce token cost up to ~30% for generative apps when using batching + quantization profiles". We can provide the benchmark artifact (benchmark-v2.csv) and a one-slide caveat: workload-dependent.

tom_sales: Also prep quick rebuttals: prospect will ask about managed vendors' convenience and managed model freshness. Need 3 short responses.

maria_marketing: Rebuttal drafts: 1) Convenience: "We offer hosted API for fastest TTV + Dedicated/Private for enterprise needs — same API across modes." 2) Freshness: "Model catalog + pinned versions + rollouts lets you control refresh cadence." 3) Ops cost: "Our routing and autoscaling reduces wasted GPU cycles." Keep very short for SDR.

josh_product: For the benchmark narrative, emphasize methodology in 1 line: "standardized gen workload (avg seq 256), identical model variants, identical QAT/quant config where applicable; routing+batching toggles measured." Add a clear footnote on dataset/workload.

sam_sdr: Draft SDR subject lines: 1) "Benchmark shows cheaper inference for production LLMs" 2) "Ship LLM features with SLA-backed latency" Draft openers: A) "Quick note — we ran a benchmark vs cloud endpoints on typical product prompts and found meaningful cost and latency wins when using serving optimizations. Can I share a 1-page summary?" B) "Hi — curious how you handle inference spikes? We route + cache to keep p99 low. 10-min call?" Thoughts?

anya_research: Those are fine. Swap the hard claim in subject 1 to "Benchmark: inference cost advantages for production LLMs" to be safe.

maria_marketing: Webinar tie-in: 10-min benchmark demo + 20-min panel (engineering + customer). CTA: landing page download + request Dedicated trial. CTA copy: "See the benchmark & request a trial". Need hero headline + 2 supporting bullets.

josh_product: Hero: "Serve LLMs predictably — across hosted, dedicated, private" Bullets: "Predictable p50/p95 latency with routing policies" and "Lower unit economics via batching + caching suggestions"

tom_sales: For inbound routing, can we add a hidden field in the landing form for "inbound intent: benchmark download" so SDRs get prioritized leads? Also tag by company size.
\maria_marketing: Yes. Ops: @deploy-bot can you confirm the form field + GA event? Also need copy for thank-you email.

deploy-bot: Reminder: landing page deploy window open 1759994000-1759994600. I will add `inbound_intent=benchmark` hidden field and emit GA event `benchmark_dl`. Will post confirmation when live.

sam_sdr: Thank-you email quick copy: Subject: "Your benchmark download — next steps" Body first line: "Thanks — attached is the short benchmark summary. Would you like a 15-min walk-through?" Include 2 CTAs: schedule, request trial.

anya_research: Also include an appendix in the download that lists test configuration (model versions, quant, sequence lengths) and a short methodology paragraph. That prevents bad apples quoting our numbers incorrectly.

maria_marketing: Owners and deadlines: Maria -> write one-pager + landing copy by EOD Tue. Josh -> benchmark one-liner + footnote slide by Tue noon. Anya -> attach methodology and approved phrasing by Tue 3pm. Sam -> SDR script and email by Tue 5pm. Tom -> inbound routing + field mapping by Tue 5pm. Deploy-bot -> land changes in deploy window and confirm.

maria_marketing: Final ask: keep battlecard < 1 page, 3 objections + 3 short soundbites, 2 outbound hooks, and 1 hero line. I'll compile and run a quick playtest on Thursday. :rocket:

tom_sales: +1. Will coordinate with SDR team for playtest slots.

deploy-bot: Deploy note posted to #eng-releases at 1759994100.

maria_marketing: Thanks — tagging owners in thread. If no objections, I'll start drafting now. :white_check_mark:
